cases.name: Jenny Dawn "Jenn" Radcliffe Ward
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Jenn graduated from Chippewa Falls high school in 1998 and went on to get a degree from Globe University as a paralegal.

She was currently employed at Lorman Education Services. Because of her love for children, she took in her nieces and nephews and many friends in an in-home daycare that she ran with her best friend Stephani Shellenberger. When her own children were in school, Jenn worked and managed various retail stores at Oakwood Mall, including Zales, becoming the family jewelry expert. Jenn was a big-hearted, caring daughter, sister, wife, mother, and friend. She always took the time to care for others and was often the life of the party. You always knew when Jenn arrived. She had many hobbies which included cooking for her family, reading, watching movies, writing, painting and creating works of art with wood pallets in her spare time.

Jenn was an active participant and volunteer at Loyal's Annual Corn Fest. She competed in the bean bag tournament and looked forward each year to bartending at the event to serve family and friends in the area.

Family was very important to Jenn. You could always find her in the action, playing cards and games, singing and challenging her siblings for the charade champion title."
cases.caseStatus: INCOMPETENT / UNFIT TO STAND TRIAL; PENDING
cases.narrative: Police say he shot her inside her home, and her husband was working at an Eau Claire gas station at the time of the shooting.
